title: Geochemical Characterization of Four Quaternary Obsidian Sources and Provenance of Obsidian Artifacts from the Middle Stone Age Site of Gademotta, Main Ethiopian Rift
version: Geoarchaeology 32(2), pp. 302–310, DOI 10.1002/gea.21579, first published online 2016. Author-uploaded text read.
lineage: Primary X-ray fluorescence comparison of archaeological obsidian and geological samples. Shares Sahle with the 2013 artifact study. The obsidian measurements are distinct evidence at assemblage scale. They do not identify each of the 2013 study objects.

passages.note: Of 26 Gademotta Formation artifacts sampled, most are assigned to the local Worja source. A minority may come from Bora or remain undetermined. Source signatures overlap for some samples. Earlier analyses from Kulkuletti involved a less certain provenance for some artifacts.
